description: Irish standard pretensioned T beams T1-T10 (380-815 mm deep, 495 mm flange, solid slab construction; 'Special Order' per Banagher). Note T1-T2 use an 85 mm web height, T3-T10 a 240 mm web height.

sources.properties_and_F_H: Banagher Precast Concrete, Bridge Beam Manual, 3rd ed., printed p. 16 (sources/banagher-bridge-beam-manual-3ed.pdf); identical tables in '05316 Precast Beam Properties.xls' (2007).
sources.profile_dims: Manual p. 16 drawing (vector PDF): vertical stack F + 50 + H + 50 + 40 + 75 + 25 = depth (verified exact for all ten sizes); top flange 205 wide; flange 495 wide with 25 chamfers (445 bottom face); shoulder/taper zones 50.

geometry.note: Exact profile, no fitting required. The vertical stack is published (chamfer 25 + flange side 75 + splay 40 + lower taper 50 + web H + upper taper 50 + top flange F = depth, exact for all ten sizes) and the horizontal dims below reproduce the published A, yc and Ixx to within 0.02% (max) when the polygon is constructed correctly. They also match the manual p.16 CAD drawing.
geometry.note_self_weight: The published T self-weights are ~4% higher than area x 24 kN/m3 (unlike the Y family where they match exactly); the tables' A column and the drawing agree with each other and are used here.

strand_note: Strand layout (xls DWG of T10, 2007-era): bottom flange two rows 13/13 at 60/110 above soffit over a 445 face with pitches 72.5|45 45 45 40 40 45 45 45 72.5; single centred strands at 240-380 and 450-770 up the web/top flange. Not yet encoded as a row table - extract from the manual appendix or DWG before relying on it.
